name: @prabhix/web-kit
description: Shared brand, UI, and OIDC packages for Prabhix product webs.
//: React lives here rather than in packages/ui, and is a peer dependency there.
When packages/ui declared react as both a peer and a dev dependency, npm satisfied the peer
with a second copy inside packages/ui/node_modules. Apps consume this package through a
`file:` link, so their bundler followed the link and found that copy - two Reacts in one
process, which fails as `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'useState')` and reads like
a bug in whichever component happens to render first. OneOps has `dedupe: ['react']` for this
reason and it was not enough under Vitest.
Declared once, at the root, there is nothing to nest.
